description.en: Searches the party roster for a member currently assigned to a given field position/figure value. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Figure/build value to match against each party member.
Second argument read by the native but not otherwise used in the traced logic.
1 if a matching party member was found, 0 if not; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments) or the roster/position data isn't ready.

example.code:
// Check whether any party member matches a given figure value
local found = CMND_SEARCH_POS_PT_MEMBER(2, 0) == 1;
